The image shows a stainless steel mixing bowl holding shredded carrots. There are a few dark items, possibly raisins or dates, partly hidden under the carrots.

For scale, the bowl looks about 25-28 cm across at the rim. The carrots cover a patch about 12 cm by 9 cm at the bottom of the bowl, and the pile is roughly 3-4 cm high. That is about 150-200 ml of loosely packed shreds, and loose shreds weigh about 0.4 g/ml, which gives roughly 70-80 g. I'll estimate 80 g of carrot.

I can see about 3 small dark pieces, which look like raisins or similar dried fruit. At roughly 3 g each, that is about 8 g. There is no visible dressing.
